title: Stripping Extras
description: A mod that adds more utility to stripping !
body:
# Stripping Extras

**Stripping Extras** improves the stripping mechanic in Minecraft by making it more intentional, useful, and less frustrating.

## Current Features

- Adds a new enchantment that prevents accidental stripping  
- When the enchantment is applied, right-clicking a log will no longer strip it unintentionally  
- Helps avoid mistakes while building or interacting with logs  

## Work in Progress

- Additional stripping-related mechanics are planned  
- New patterns and motifs are currently in development  
- More utilities and interactions will be added in future updates  

## Design Philosophy

This mod is designed as a Vanilla+ quality-of-life improvement, keeping the original Minecraft feel while fixing a common gameplay frustration.

Ideal for builders, survival players, and lightweight modpacks.
